design_rationale:
STEP 0 -- asset ledger & claim. This is task 0 of 2 for membership_lifecycle; no other task exists
yet, so nothing is occupied. Claiming: root membership_ext_dues_waiver_medical_hold (on_request,
subject=membership_dues_waived, base_policy_refs=[membership_tier_dues_billing]) plus its two
value_input prerequisites membership_ext_enrollment_fee and membership_ext_recurring_dues (both
state_due, subject=membership_dues_charge, base_policy_refs=[membership_tier_dues_billing,
membership_corporate_bundling, membership_early_termination_fee]). Reserved for task 1 (the
workflow task): membership_ext_late_fee, membership_ext_reactivation_settlement,
membership_ext_early_termination_fee, and the single workflow -- all disjoint tools/policies, no
overlap. This leaves task 1 an independent problem tree of >=4 write steps rooted at the
past-due-cancellation-settlement workflow.

Design thesis: the customer volunteers only "please apply my medical-hold dues waiver" -- she never
names the enrollment-fee gap or this cycle's uncharged dues (both are read out of the ledger and
the published rule by the agent, per the problem-tree card below). Core scored parameter: the club's
own waiver amount (amount_usd of waive_dues_medical_hold). Depth: surface goal -> "is
dues_waiver_medical_hold_allowed available" -> "what IS the outstanding balance right now" ->
discover the enrollment_fee row is missing and this cycle's recurring_dues is unbilled -> compute
each, in either order (parallel, proven commutative below) -> recompute the true outstanding
balance -> apply the employer-funded offset -> waive the remainder. Breadth: student-tier discount
branch (untriggered here, Metro Multi-Club is not Student Metro Access), corporate employer_pct +
multi_location_discount_pct cross-category factors (multi_location_discount_pct=0 for Startup
Partner -- a real, untriggered branch), 3 rolling months of settled history that must be
distinguished from the two new unbilled charges.

Base-invariant card: membership_tier_dues_billing.dues_charge_requires_open_contract (state) --
allowed=[applied,active,frozen,past_due,cancel_pending]; membership_holdings.status='frozen' here,
in the allowed set, satisfied. membership_corporate_bundling.corporate_discount_requires_active_enrollment
(state) -- corporate_wellness_enrollments[corp0].status='active', customer_id=cust0, satisfied.
membership_early_termination_fee.within_minimum_term (time) -- anchor=opened_date=2024-12-05,
duration=minimum_term_months=12 (Metro Multi-Club), relation=not_after, boundary=exclusive;
frozen_time=2025-03-10 is only ~3 months after opened_date, well inside the 12-month window, so
satisfied; boundary case: at 2025-12-05 the window closes (exclusive), and any date on/after that
would fail. membership_tier_dues_billing has no gate applicable to membership_dues_waived subject
(policy_scope only).

Business-object card: target object = membership_holdings[memb0] for cust0. Correlation key =
membership_id. Rows entering the waiver's SUM aggregates: e1..e3 (settled Dec/Jan/Feb recurring_dues,
each with a matching payment p1..p3, net zero) plus the two NEW rows this call posts (enrollment_fee
and March recurring_dues, both unpaid) -- those two unpaid rows are exactly and only the outstanding
balance the waiver clears. No other holding/customer is seeded, so no cross-object leakage is
possible.

Problem-tree card: root=membership_ext_dues_waiver_medical_hold. Edge 1 (value_input) ->
membership_ext_enrollment_fee: condition "the one-time enrollment_fee_usd charge for this contract
must already be posted to the ledger before the outstanding balance available to waive is
computed"; policy_source quoted verbatim from the root's own rule; unresolved at frozen_time because
initial_state.membership_events contains no row with membership_id=memb0 and charge_type=
enrollment_fee (checked row by row above: e1,e2,e3 are all charge_type=recurring_dues); resolved_by
charge_enrollment_fee_91320c6d. Edge 2 (value_input) -> membership_ext_recurring_dues: condition
"this billing cycle's recurring_dues charge for this contract must already be posted..."; unresolved
because no membership_events row exists with billing_cycle_month=2025-03 (or any March charge) at the
opening; resolved_by charge_recurring_dues_93751e4d. Both edges are value_input because enrollment_
posted / recurring_posted are compute bindings of the root directly summed into outstanding_balance
(deletion-sensitivity run below). Order between the two prerequisites is unconstrained (parallel,
fan-out from the root): total_charges = enrollment_posted + recurring_posted is a commutative sum,
so charging enrollment_fee then recurring_dues, or the reverse, produces the identical
outstanding_balance, employer_funded, and result -- verified: charging in either order yields
enrollment_posted=44.10 and recurring_posted=40.49 regardless of which lands first, since neither
formula reads the other's posted row. no_user_hint: user_scenario (below) never mentions an
enrollment fee, a billing gap, or "check something else first" -- Priya only asks for the medical
waiver and answers identity/verification questions. tools_do_not_block: waive_dues_medical_hold_
6b86f7b6's implementation performs no read of membership_events at all and no eligibility check; it
blindly posts whatever amount_usd it is given and decrements dues_balance -- calling it before the
two charges are posted would simply waive $0.00 or whatever stale balance existed, silently
understating the waiver rather than refusing.

Deletion sensitivity (Step 5 prerequisite-sensitivity run, executed by hand against the compute
above and re-verified by check_compute.py's own value_input replay): skipping
charge_enrollment_fee_91320c6d leaves enrollment_posted=0.00 (vs 44.10 with it landed), dropping
outstanding_balance from 84.59 to 40.49 and the final waiver from 76.13 to 36.44 -- edge 1 is
load-bearing. Skipping charge_recurring_dues_93751e4d leaves recurring_posted=0.00 (vs 40.49),
dropping outstanding_balance to 44.10 and the final waiver to 39.69 -- edge 2 is load-bearing.

Standard solution / verification: locate & verify Priya, read membership_holdings[memb0] (status=
frozen, dues_balance=0.00 at open) and membership_events (3 settled recurring_dues+payment pairs,
no enrollment_fee row, no March charge) and corporate_wellness_enrollments[corp0] (Startup Partner,
active). Compute membership_ext_enrollment_fee: base_fee=P('enrollment_fee_usd')=49.00,
corp_active=True, employer_pct=CPARAM('corp','employer_discount_pct')=10,
multi_loc_pct=CPARAM('corp','multi_location_discount_pct')=0 (untriggered -- Startup Partner does
not offer a multi-location discount), result=RND(49.00*(1-10/100),2)=44.10. Compute
membership_ext_recurring_dues: base_amt=P('monthly_dues_usd')=44.99, employer_pct=10, student_pct=
P('student_discount_pct')=0, discount_pct=MX(10,0)=10, result=RND(44.99*0.90,2)=40.49. Compute
membership_ext_dues_waiver_medical_hold at handling time (after both charges land):
enrollment_posted=SUM(charge_type=enrollment_fee)=44.10, recurring_posted=SUM(charge_type=
recurring_dues)=44.99*3(settled)+40.49(new)=175.46, total_charges=219.56, payments_received=
SUM(membership_payment_received)=44.99*3=134.97, prior_waivers=0, outstanding_balance=219.56-
134.97-0=84.59, employer_pct=10, multi_loc_pct=0, employer_funded=RND(84.59*10/100,2)=8.46,
result=RND(84.59-8.46,2)=76.13. This has been executed as plain Python (see the design-note
computation trail above and re-run against check_compute.py) and matches computations[].expected
and the gold arguments exactly.

Draft recomputation from the visible context alone (masking compute/expected/GT): a rollout agent
reading only the published KB, the tool schemas and Priya's own words would: verify identity (2 of
phone/DOB/photo-id-last4/member-since all match); read the membership holding and its full event
history; notice the enrollment_fee charge_type never appears and the current billing cycle's
recurring_dues charge_type never appears either, while the rule for membership_ext_dues_waiver_
medical_hold requires "the sum of every membership_dues_charge amount ever billed to the contract
with billing subtype enrollment_fee or recurring_dues" as the waiver's base -- so both catch-up
charges must be posted first; read the corporate wellness enrollment,
apply the documented per-policy formulas for each of the three writes, and post them in the fixed
topological order (either catch-up charge first, then the waiver last). This agrees with gold.

Rework round 2 (policy-task audit response, revision 2 of this task file): closed the charter-global rule/compute mismatch (_difficulty.md Check-2 finding; observation in this file's prior revision) in membership_ext_dues_waiver_medical_hold by narrowing the rule's "every membership_dues_charge amount ever billed" clause to the two charge_types the compute actually sums (enrollment_fee, recurring_dues), matching compute exactly and excluding late_fee/early_termination_fee explicitly rather than by silent omission; mirrored the new rule wording into this task's own prerequisite_closure.edges[0].policy_source and the corresponding design-note sentence above. This does not change this task's scored value (this contract's membership_events history has no late_fee/early_termination_fee row either before or after this fix, so the sum is identical), and does not affect task 1 (a disjoint policy, never claimed there). user_scenario: Priya Anand calls the club's contact center sounding a little apologetic about bothering them. She explains that she's currently on a medical freeze from her membership -- she had a minor procedure and her doctor's office already sent over the documentation to the front desk a couple of weeks ago -- and the club had told her at the time that her dues would be waived for as long as she's on this hold. She just wants to make sure that waiver actually gets applied to her account and to hear what her balance looks like once it's done. She doesn't know or care about the mechanics of how the number is calculated; she just wants it handled and to be told the final number. If asked to confirm her identity, she gives her phone number as 2125550101 and, if asked for a second detail, her date of birth, 1994-06-18; if asked further she can also give the last four digits of her photo ID, 4821, or say she's been a member since December 5th of last year. She knows her membership is the Metro Multi-Club Access plan and that she also gets a discount through her employer, Bright Peak Studios, which offers some kind of corporate wellness partnership with the club, though she has no idea what percentage that actually comes out to or how it interacts with anything else on her bill -- if asked, she just says 'I think it's through my work, Bright Peak Studios, but I don't know the details, you'd have to look that up.' She never mentions an enrollment fee, never says anything about this month's dues, and never suggests that anything besides the waiver itself needs attention -- as far as she's concerned, the only open item on her account is the medical-hold waiver she was promised. If the representative reports back that some other charge had to be sorted out first, she just says 'Oh, okay, whatever you need to do -- as long as it ends with that waiver applied,' without asking for specifics. Once the representative tells her the waiver has been posted and states her account's new balance, she thanks them and says that's all she needed; she does not ask for anything further and does not request any document be sent or any address be updated.
